operating_income.source: us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss, 10-K 0001558370-24-016169 (FY2023, FY2024); FY2025 not found in the XBRL data (null)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: revenue fell from 61,251 to 45,684 (FY2023-FY2025) as the ag cycle troughed; modest decline then recovery, fading to 4%. Analyst judgment, not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2023 21.2% and FY2024 17.5% (computed from filed EBIT/revenue); FY2025 EBIT not found. 16% assumed as trough-to-mid-cycle.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate US federal 21% plus state/foreign mix; not taken from a filing.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta ~1.1 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran, US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.8% cost of equity; assumed capital-structure blend with after-tax cost of debt ~4.5% gives ~9.0%. Beta not pulled from the tool; assumption.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = debt_current 13,796 - cash 8,276 (10-K 0001104659-25-122321). Caveat: the tool flags that no long-term debt was reported, so this likely understates Deere's total debt (including financial services borrowings). Reviewer should verify.
